properties.label: Aligned unequal workbench
properties.text: Arrange four unequal but aligned light widgets beneath a large editorial heading: note paper, a contrast specimen, a radius instrument and a review checklist.

properties.label: Four functional widget anatomies
properties.text: Combine paper grain and edges, an oversized Aa specimen, miniature ruler ticks, a visibly changing shape and a precise completion mark. Each widget has a different anatomy while sharing one visual family.

properties.label: White, sage and green
properties.text: Use white and pale sage surfaces with dark green ink.

properties.label: Shared tactile edges
properties.text: Maintain one family of tactile edges and shadows across all four widgets.

properties.label: Working native controls
properties.text: Keep notes for the session, swap contrast colors with a computed ratio, change radius with a range input and update the completion count with checkboxes. Label session-only persistence honestly and make every control keyboard-operable.

properties.label: No decorative controls
properties.text: Do not deliver decorative mock controls or fake contrast numbers. Review every widget state.

properties.label: Readable mobile workbench
properties.text: Reflow all four widgets into a readable mobile workbench.
